BEFORE YOU DIVE IN

A few things
worth knowing.

Read the documentation ↗
Which chains does Sift support?+

Sift currently scouts Solana. More chains are planned; they are not available yet. Each new chain will need its own data and evidence coverage.

Can I use Sift right now?+

Sift is in private testing. Anyone can explore the web interface. Signing in, loading saved data, and running scans require an approved tester account and the running bot’s web connection. Public access and pricing have not been announced.

How do the app and Telegram work together?+

They share your account, screening rules, and saved observations. Send /web privately to @SiftAgentbot to request a one-time sign-in link. Telegram is currently the only sign-in method. If web access is not enabled on the running bot, the public interface remains available to explore without connected data.

What happens when evidence is missing?+

Unknown required evidence blocks qualification. Complete bundle detection and universal liquidity-lock verification are not available. Sift keeps those limits visible; a market match is not a guarantee of safety or profit.

Does Sift trade or connect to my wallet?+

No. Sift supports research and monitoring. It does not connect to your wallet, hold funds, or execute trades. You decide what to do with the evidence.

Can my Telegram group use Sift?+

An eligible group admin configures Sift privately, verifies the group, and explicitly enables alerts. Adding the bot alone does not start scans or send messages to the group.
